conditions: Bodies are compared as class-file data. No vendor class is loaded or initialized.
Equal body digests prove equal local logic modulo renaming only. Flags are compared separately.
Callee bodies outside the compared role and callee set are not covered.
A changed body needs a decision under D52 before any admission.
A body with an invokedynamic call site is compared with the explicit dynamic contract. It keeps every bootstrap payload. It does not run the bootstrap.
The diff positions are instruction ordinals. Member labels follow first use, so one added reference can relabel later tokens.
